plainText:
Noriaki Kanze (Japanese: 観世智顕 Kanze Noriaki) is a Japanese voice actor for . 

==Biography==
Kanze was born sometime on October 15. He started working on the with , voicing a number of characters, most notably Ren, one of Professor Cerise's assistants; and some of Goh's Pokémon. Kanze is currently affiliated with .
